adaptations: app/jev/policy.mjs ports the indexed action space and TypeSafe decision request; app/jev/browser.mjs adapts guarded CDP execution. snapshot.js also resolves styled native checkbox/radio inputs through their associated visible HTML labels, with identity guards and hit testing. Jobloop's existing agent supplies text and authorizes each action. Jobloop adds modal-scoped hit-tested controls, exact native-select support, nested scroll targets and compact observations through app/jev/navigation.mjs. Associated autocomplete suggestions include field-scoped role-less dropdown items and ARIA options; exact query/select/verify uses app/jev/autocomplete.mjs. Hidden dropdown errors and options are excluded from input names. Transparent native selects laid over styled captions are observed as controls when a hit test lands on them (operableSelect), and every select reports selectedLabel and its first option names. Custom dropdowns (a non-input combobox or a labelled aria-haspopup button) are autocomplete controls whose popup listbox/tree is found by aria-controls, a shared aria-labelledby or focus while expanded; their caption is the selected value.
